9e2e2aeda14fb1cd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة صحة الرجل للتشغيل والصيانة عن مدرب رياضي للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير القدرات البدنية والنفسية للاعبين، وإعداد الخطط التدريبية، وتقييم الأداء لضمان تحقيق الأهداف الرياضية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اكتشاف ميول اللاعبين ومواهبهم واستعداداتهم، وإعداد خطط لتنميتها وتعزيزها وتنفيذها. إعداد الخطط التدريبية قصيرة وطويلة الأمد، وتطويرها، وتحديد عناصر اللياقة البدنية وتنميتها. تطوير المهارات الأساسية للعبة الرياضية التي يتم تدريبها، وتدريب اللاعبين عليها، وتقييم أدائهم، وتنمية مهاراتهم. إدارة المقابلات الرياضية، وتوجيه اللاعبين وتبديلهم وفقًا لسير المقابلة. تطبيق قوانين وقواعد اللعبة ومتابعة تطورها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على اكتشاف المواهب وتطويرها. فهم عميق لقوانين وقواعد اللعبة الرياضية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوجيه. القدرة على إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم الأداء. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة ينبع، بالمدينة المنورة، ضمن مؤسسة صحة الرجل للتشغيل والصيانة. سيتم العمل في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تطوير القدرات الرياضية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

9ea6f8232632bb0f.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an Optical Technician to join their team. This role contributes to the overall delivery of optical health services within the group. Key Responsibilities and Duties Assisting patients with frame selection and fitting. Taking accurate measurements for prescription lenses. Performing minor repairs and adjustments to eyewear. Maintaining and organizing optical inventory. 9eb49c61b00ae0b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الواجهات الغربية للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على العمل في مشاريع تشغيل وصيانة أنظمة مكافحة وإنذار الحريق في المنافذ الحدودية، بما يتوافق مع متطلبات المشروع المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وصيانة أنظمة الإنذار المختلفة. إجراء اختبارات شاملة للوحات والأجهزة لضمان كفاءتها. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإصلاحها بفعالية. إعداد تقارير الصيانة الدورية والخاصة بالتدخلات الفنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لأنظمة مكافحة وإنذار الحريق. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل سيعمل الفني في بيئة مشاريع حيوية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير الفنية. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل في المنافذ الحدودية، مما يستدعي القدرة على التكيف مع متطلبات هذه المواقع. نوع التوظيف هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة المهنية.

Initiate identified and valuable business relationships, developing these over time. Ensure transparent and efficient communication with all members of SEVEN supporting their requirements Strategy Implementation Implement and execute the Commercial Strategy & action plan Contribute to the planning and execution of the strategic vision, goals and execution road map Ensure effective support is provided to the overall business, engaged in the development of the Business Plan together with the individual Projects’ Business Cases & Strategies Contribute to developing KPI’s for the Business, Project and Function aligning with Project / Business Execution Plans and the function strategy. Simplify complex issues and develop scenarios to enable Responsible Decision Making Ensure the DoA is respected and adhered under all circumstance Contract Management Review contract documentation and provide contractual support as a subject matter expert Ensure that all securities, Insurance and warranties are in place in accordance with the contractual obligations of stakeholders. Ensure that compliance is maintained. Bid Summaries / Purchase Orders / Payments Expedite Provisional Sum procurement for approval. Oversight and coordination of the tendering of provisional sum

9e342343239a6094.description: About the Role TÜV Rheinland is seeking a Senior Team Leader - Accounts Payable. This is a full-time senior operational leadership position responsible for Accounts Payable (AP) performance, transformation delivery, and fostering strong business partnerships across Europe. The role requires a combination of strong people leadership with data-driven performance management and credible business partnership. Key Responsibilities Lead and develop Accounts Payable teams, setting clear expectations for service delivery, quality, and controls. Manage AP operational performance across assigned countries and processes, including invoice throughput, ageing, backlog, payment timeliness, and query resolution. Translate KPIs and operational data into concrete recovery and improvement plans, identifying deviations and ensuring timely actions. Co-own the delivery of the AP automation and autoposting roadmap, including vendor activation and exception reduction. Lead improvements to AP query management by reducing manual handling and supporting scalable workflow solutions. Deliver a portfolio of AP projects from design through implementation and stabilization, with clear scope and risk management. Act as a senior AP partner for Business Partners and corporate finance stakeholders, ensuring transparent performance discussions. Drive joint improvement actions with Procurement, Master Data, Treasury, Controlling, IT, and local business teams. Ensure effective execution and evidence of AP internal controls, coordinating remediation of findings and maintaining audit readiness. Oversee payment operations and critical deadlines, ensuring appropriate segregation of duties and business continuity. Qualifications and Experience Minimum 7 years of relevant Finance Operations experience. At least 4 years in a people-leadership role within an international SSC/BPO or complex AP environment. Proven track record of improving AP performance and delivering measurable outcomes in areas such as automation, invoice processing, or query handling. Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable, SAP, and invoice workflow solutions such as VIM. Hands-on experience leading multiple projects or transformation initiatives with competing priorities. Ability to work with operational data, identify root causes, set targets, and convert analysis into accountable action plans. Required Skills Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge senior partners constructively. Visible leadership style that builds ownership and develops team members. Strong governance mindset with practical knowledge of internal controls, audit requirements, and risk management. Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of providing concise executive updates and leading operational discussions. Benefits A highly visible leadership role with direct influence on AP transformation and service performance across Europe. Ownership of strategic initiatives including autoposting, query management, and process standardization. A development path towards broader operational leadership or global process ownership roles. An international environment with close cooperation across Finance, Business, Procurement, IT, and Transformation teams. Stable employment contract with an annual bonus. Hybrid work model (minimum 2 days per week in office) and flexible working hours. Benefit package including private medical care, co-financing of sports cards, discounts, shopping vouchers, and the possibility of joining group insurance. Employee Assistance Program and Employee referral program.

9e99dd8caf535cb4.description: About the Role Carrier is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to join the team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The Senior Sales Engineer will drive sales growth by developing new business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the successful conversion of HVAC projects into orders. Identify and pursue new business opportunities across the HVAC market in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia. Prepare and submit competitive quotations and proposals, and proactively follow up to convert opportunities into orders. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify potential leads and growth opportunities. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to support business bookings and achieve assigned sales targets. Develop and execute account strategies for key customers to maximize business opportunities and profitability. Identify and pursue large-scale HVAC projects, working closely with internal teams to support successful project acquisition. Review bid opportunities, contribute to bid preparation, and participate in commercial negotiations with prospective customers. Develop new customer contacts and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers to influence purchasing decisions. Collaborate with relevant internal teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and appropriate solutions are proposed. 9e9de76440cb3b71.description: About the Role Gulfmaid is seeking a Sales Executive to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving B2B sales for Gulfmaid’s household plastic products within the region. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in sales, with a focus on customer acquisition and relationship management. Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and coordinate customer orders. Monitor sales performance, revenue targets, and market trends. 9ec284add439dc68.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a BIM Engineer to support a flagship mega infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing and maintaining Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes throughout the project lifecycle. The program includes large-scale infrastructure networks, utilities, transportation systems, public realm developments, landscape assets, smart city technologies, and multidisciplinary engineering components delivered through a collaborative digital environment. Role Context and Contribution Working within the PMCM team, the BIM Engineer will contribute to the development, coordination, validation, and management of BIM models, digital delivery standards, and information management processes. This position requires close collaboration with design consultants, contractors, project managers, and stakeholders to drive model-based planning, design coordination, construction management, and asset information delivery, ensuring successful project execution. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of project BIM Execution Plans (BEP), information management strategies, and digital delivery requirements. Review and validate BIM models, drawings, and associated project information for compliance with client standards and project objectives. Coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models across civil, structural, utilities, landscape, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and infrastructure disciplines. Facilitate clash detection, model coordination, constructability reviews, and issue resolution using BIM platforms and collaboration tools. Monitor BIM deliverables from consultants and contractors to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with project BIM standards. Support the integration of BIM with GIS, digital twin platforms, asset information models, and other project technologies where applicable. Maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows and ensure effective information exchange between project stakeholders. Generate and review model-based outputs including drawings, schedules, quantity take-offs, visualizations, and construction sequencing simulations. Assist project teams in implementing 4D and 5D BIM methodologies to support planning, scheduling, and cost management activities. Conduct BIM model audits, quality assurance reviews, and compliance checks throughout the project lifecycle. Provide BIM technical support and guidance to project teams, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders. Assist with data management, asset information requirements, and digital handover deliverables. Participate in digital engineering workshops, coordination meetings, and innovation initiatives supporting project delivery. Ensure compliance with international BIM standards, client requirements, and PMCM governance procedures. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in BIM engineering, preferably within large-scale infrastructure or landscape development projects. A strong understanding of BIM processes, digital delivery standards, and information management strategies is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a PMCM team on a significant infrastructure and landscape development project. The role involves a collaborative digital environment and interaction with various project stakeholders.

9e97a8f032af7032.description: About the Role TAWANTECH is seeking an experienced Senior Nintex K2 Developer to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining Business Process Management (BPM) and Digital Process Automation (DPA) solutions. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of relevant development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in the Nintex K2 platform. Role Overview The Senior Nintex K2 Developer will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, optimizing business processes, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of automated workflows. This position requires strong proficiency in workflow automation, digital forms, and enterprise system integrations within the K2 environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, and maintain business process automation solutions using Nintex K2. Develop and maintain K2 workflows, SmartForms, SmartObjects, business rules, and approval processes. Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications and workflow designs. Build automated business processes, including approvals, notifications, escalations, and exception handling. Integrate K2 solutions with enterprise applications, databases, SharePoint, and external systems. Develop and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and SQL Server. Customize K2 applications using C#, .NET, JavaScript, or other relevant technologies where required. Troubleshoot workflow failures, resolve production issues, and optimize application performance. Support solution deployment, testing, documentation, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, project managers, and other technical teams. Ensure solutions meet business, security, performance, and scalability requirements. Recommend improvements to existing workflows and automation processes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional development experience. Proven hands-on experience with the Nintex K2 platform, such as K2 Five, K2 Cloud, or K2 blackpearl. Strong experience in BPM, workflow development, and digital process automation. Practical experience with K2 SmartForms, SmartObjects, and workflow design. Strong knowledge of SQL Server and database integration. Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and/or SOAP web services. Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft technologies. Working knowledge of C#, .NET, and JavaScript for application customization and integration. Required Skills Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with business stakeholders and convert functional requirements into technical solutions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to work on critical business process automation initiatives within a collaborative team environment.

Maintain and monitor general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards and internal policies. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual account reconciliations and supporting schedules. Support financial closing activities and ensure timely completion of month-end and year-end processes. Assist in the preparation of financial statements, management reports, and regulatory reporting requirements. Analyze accounting data, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions as necessary. Ensure compliance with IFRS, corporate accounting policies, internal controls, and governance requirements. Support internal and external audit activities by preparing documentation, responding to audit inquiries, and implementing recommendations. Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Procurement, and other business functions to resolve accounting-related matters. Review financial transactions for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate accounting treatment. Contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and automation initiatives within the accounting function. Provide technical guidance and support to junior accounting team members as required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in accounting. Demonstrated ability to perform and oversee complex accounting activities. Strong understanding of accounting standards, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements. Proficiency in financial reporting processes and general ledger management. Skills and Attributes Technical accounting expertise. Analytical skills for investigating variances and recommending corrective actions. Knowledge of IFRS and internal control frameworks. Ability to coordinate with various internal departments. Key Responsibilities Promote and inform employees about available training programs. Demonstrate leadership in guest hospitality and customer service, fostering a positive atmosphere. Assist employees in identifying specific behaviors that contribute to service excellence. Ensure employees receive ongoing training to understand guest expectations and satisfaction skills. Conduct needs assessments, design, and develop training programs. Facilitate the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Observe employee service behaviors and provide constructive feedback. Training Program Effectiveness and Development Monitor enrollment and attendance in training classes and assess participant progress. Collaborate with operational leaders to evaluate employees' technical and leadership skills post-training. Review guest satisfaction data and other feedback to identify areas for improvement. Measure the transfer of learning from training courses to daily operations. Ensure adult learning principles are integrated into all training programs. Identify performance gaps and work with managers to implement appropriate training solutions. Align current training and development programs with key business indicators and brand values. Help manage departmental controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Utilize P-card as appropriate for monitoring departmental expenditures. Understanding of effective training methods and adult learning principles. The role involves working collaboratively to enhance employee skills and organizational performance through structured training initiatives.

9ee8150420fafdc3.description: About the Role Dallah Healthcare is seeking a Building Management System Engineer to facilitate the design, implementation, and maintenance of its Building Management System (BMS). This full-time role is crucial for enhancing the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of the facility, ensuring seamless operation of critical systems, and providing a comfortable and secure environment for patients, staff, and visitors. The position requires 4-6 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage Dallah Healthcare’s BMS within pre-set guidelines, policies, and procedures. This involves ensuring the system operates effectively to support facility operations, optimize energy use, and maintain a safe environment for all occupants. Key Responsibilities Facilitate the design and configuration of the BMS to monitor and control facility aspects including HVAC, lighting, security, and energy management. Install and set up BMS hardware and software components, ensuring proper functionality and interoperability. Implement energy-efficient strategies by fine-tuning BMS settings to optimize HVAC, lighting, and equipment operation. Develop and maintain protocols for system operation during emergencies or power outages to ensure continued functionality of critical systems. Create operation manuals and guidelines for staff reference when using the BMS. Configure alarm thresholds and notifications within the BMS for prompt response to critical issues such as temperature deviations or system failures. Respond promptly to alarms and anomalies, collaborating with the Maintenance team to address issues. Integrate BMS controls with fire safety and emergency response systems. Implement software updates, patches, and upgrades to keep the BMS current and secure. Ensure the BMS aligns with healthcare regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices. Adhere to rigorous building codes and regulations governing system controls, upholding safety and legal standards. Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and testing of the BMS to ensure optimal performance and adherence to operational standards. Gather and analyze data from the BMS to generate performance reports, trends, and key insights, ensuring timely reporting to stakeholders. Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, settings, changes, and troubleshooting procedures. Analyze system logs and diagnostics to identify root causes of issues and implement effective solutions. Provide actionable recommendations for system optimization and efficiency enhancements based on data analysis. Organizational Accountabilities Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure controlled and consistent work. Promote the implementation and adherence to relevant policies, processes, and operating procedures. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices, considering leading practices, cost reduction, and productivity improvement. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure safety, legislative compliance, high-quality service, and a responsible environmental attitude. Build trust and understanding with key internal and external stakeholders to promote full compliance with industry regulations and a broader understanding of Dallah Healthcare’s interests and practices. Experience Required 4-6 years of experience in Building Management Systems or a related field. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position at Dallah Healthcare.

9e0f4c08c93d1ccb.description: نبحث عن أخصائي إدارة حسابات تواصل اجتماعي مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجيات المحتوى والتفاعل عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إنشاء وإدارة حملات تسويقية رقمية مبتكرة، وتحليل الأداء لضمان تحقيق أهداف الشركة. إذا كنت تمتلك شغفاً بالتواصل الرقمي وقدرة على بناء مجتمعات عبر الإنترنت، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام الرئيسية: * تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المحتوى لجميع قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي. * إنشاء محتوى جذاب ومتنوع (صور، فيديوهات، نصوص) يتوافق مع هوية العلامة التجارية. * إدارة الحملات الإعلانية المدفوعة على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. * مراقبة وتحليل أداء الحملات وتقديم تقارير دورية. * التفاعل مع المتابعين والرد على استفساراتهم وتعليقاتهم. * متابعة أحدث الاتجاهات في مجال التسويق الرقمي ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

9e4032a807379c08.company_name: مؤسسة محمد ناصر محمد العجاجي للسيارات
9e4032a807379c08.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة محمد ناصر محمد العجاجي للسيارات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات مع العملاء، تقديم عروض بيع فعالة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة عمليات البيع والتحصيل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة.

9eeaa9a82b477f5f.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking a Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer (ICA) to lead mechanical commissioning projects in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing the entire commissioning lifecycle, from initial checks to final client handover, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project specifications. Commissioning Leadership and Execution Lead the full lifecycle of mechanical commissioning, including pre-commissioning checks, static testing, Functional Performance Testing (FPT), and final client handover. Develop, review, and approve Commissioning Plans, Method Statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and functional testing scripts for all mechanical systems. Direct and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) for major mechanical equipment. Technical Scope and System Oversight Oversee testing and balancing of Air Handling Units (AHUs), Fan Coil Units (FCUs), Chillers, Cooling Towers, Pumps, Heat Exchangers, and Ventilation Fans. Validate plumbing, drainage, domestic water booster systems, and fire protection networks, including sprinklers, fire pumps, and deluge systems. Coordinate the integration of mechanical equipment with Building Management Systems (BMS), smoke management systems, and life safety controls. Quality, Compliance, and Issue Resolution Ensure all site operations comply with project specifications, ASHRAE guidelines, CIBSE standards, and local statutory requirements. Review mechanical shop drawings, schematic diagrams, and technical submittals to proactively identify coordination or commissioning roadblocks. Track, manage, and drive resolution for all mechanical snags and non-conformance reports using project management and commissioning software such as CxAlloy or Oracle Aconex. Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting Act as the primary technical liaison for mechanical services with clients, main contractors, consultants, and local authorities. Lead technical coordination meetings and deliver regular progress updates to multidisciplinary project teams. Compile and submit comprehensive commissioning documentation, static/dynamic test records, and final O&M handover packages. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer will be an integral part of Alpin's project teams, ensuring the successful delivery of mechanical commissioning projects.

9e046a699134bc2d.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Captain Bellstand to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on providing exceptional guest service and support within the hotel environment. The role involves direct interaction with guests, ensuring their needs are met efficiently and professionally. Key Responsibilities Greet guests and provide information on property amenities, services, hours of operation, and local attractions. Assist guests and visitors with entering and leaving the property, including opening doors and helping with luggage. Manage luggage storage and retrieval, and transport guest luggage to and from rooms or designated areas. Assist guests with loading and unloading luggage from vehicles and provide directions as needed. Arrange transportation services (*, taxi, shuttle, limousine) for guests and record advance requests. Dispatch bell staff or valet staff as required and communicate parking procedures to guests. Follow up with guests to ensure satisfaction with requests and problem resolution. Leadership and Team Support Serve as a departmental role model and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Operational Standards and Guest Service Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Capacity to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire shift. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Skill in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Capability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support the operational needs of the department.

9e44df6e6d4ee6de.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبراج كود للمقاولات عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الجبيل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يركز الدور على تحليل السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لدعم الأنشطة التسويقية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين ووضع سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية والدعائية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق النهائية، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المتخصصة في مجال التسويق واختبارات السوق. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في مدينة الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية. التقديم نرحب بالمرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات هذا الدور للتقديم.

9eee8c7c1c59fea8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة السرر الامريكيه عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، قرية العليا. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وإدارة عمليات البيع اليومية. وهو مناسب للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى البائع مسؤولية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتقديم معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات واستخداماتها وأسعارها. كما يشمل الدور معالجة المدفوعات وضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وميزاتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة واحترافية. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقًا لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على شرح تفاصيل المنتجات بوضوح. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة قرية العليا. يعمل البائع ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء وإدارة مهام المبيعات اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

9e11fe8e4f542d55.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Engineer - Infrastructure to join their team in Al Khafji, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the planning, design, and delivery of infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure infrastructure works are executed efficiently, safely, and in compliance with technical specifications and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Support the supervision and monitoring of infrastructure construction activities, including roads, earthworks, drainage systems, and utility networks (water, sewerage, electrical, and telecom). Conduct technical reviews of contractor submissions, including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, and construction programs. Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and contractual requirements. Perform site inspections, testing, and quality assurance activities to ensure all works meet project standards and specifications. Coordinate with contractors, clients, utility authorities, designers, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues and maintain project momentum. Prepare and maintain accurate site records, progress reports, inspection documentation, and project files. Analyze construction programs and identify potential delays, risks, or resource constraints that may impact project delivery. Support the review of Inspection Requests (IRs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). Assist in monitoring interfaces between different infrastructure components to ensure seamless integration. Participate in progress meetings and provide clear, analytical updates on project performance and outstanding works. Ensure compliance with project quality, health and safety, and environmental requirements at all times. Support commissioning activities and handover documentation, including as-built records and operational manuals. Collaborate with the project team to identify innovative solutions and process improvements for infrastructure delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in infrastructure development projects. Demonstrated ability to support the planning, design, and delivery of infrastructure works. Experience in monitoring construction activities, quality standards, and compliance. Proficiency in conducting technical reviews and preparing project documentation. Work Environment and Benefits This position is based in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. AECOM offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of its employees. Depending on employment status, benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and an employee stock purchase plan. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the hiring process.

9e6016b3dd58cfbf.description: Position Overview The Associate Commercial Director will provide strategic commercial leadership and oversight of commercial, procurement, and cost management functions across large-scale, complex mega projects in the GCC region. The role involves managing commercial strategies, contractual obligations, procurement activities, cost control, and financial performance to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets and contractual requirements. The successful candidate will have extensive experience working on major developments within either a Project Management Consultancy (PMC), contracting organization, or a combination of both, with a strong understanding of the GCC construction and infrastructure market. Key Responsibilities Commercial Management: Lead and oversee commercial management activities, including contract administration, commercial negotiations, claims management, variations, and contractual risk mitigation across major projects. Cost Management and Control: Provide strategic oversight of project cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost reporting, financial controls, and expenditure monitoring to ensure effective cost management and budget compliance. Procurement Management: Direct procurement strategies, tendering processes, contract negotiations, supplier and subcontractor management, and commercial evaluation to achieve value for money and project objectives. Contract Administration: Ensure effective management of contractual obligations, including payment certifications, change management, claims assessment, dispute resolution, and contractual compliance. Commercial Strategy: Develop and implement commercial policies, procedures, frameworks, and strategies aligned with organizational objectives and project delivery requirements. Financial Performance: Monitor project commercial performance, identify financial and contractual risks, and provide recommendations to senior management on cost optimization and commercial improvements. Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, and other key stakeholders to resolve commercial issues and protect project interests. Leadership and Governance: Lead, mentor, and develop commercial, procurement, quantity surveying, and cost management teams, ensuring consistent application of commercial standards and best practices. Reporting and Advisory: Provide senior-level commercial advice, management reports, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership on project financial performance, contractual exposure, procurement status, and commercial risks. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 18 years of professional experience in commercial management, procurement, quantity surveying, and cost management within the construction and infrastructure sectors. Extensive experience in managing the commercial aspects of large-scale mega projects within the GCC, preferably in Saudi Arabia. Proven experience working with Project Management Consultancies (PMC), main contractors, or a combination of both. Strong track record in commercial leadership, contract administration, procurement strategy, cost control, claims management, and commercial negotiations. Demonstrated experience managing complex contracts, high-value procurement packages, project budgets, and commercial risks. Extensive knowledge of international contract forms, particularly FIDIC, and GCC construction contractual practices. Experience leading multidisciplinary commercial and procurement teams across complex, multi-package developments. Strong understanding of project financial management, cost forecasting, value engineering, and commercial governance. Excellent leadership, negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and decision-making skills. Professional certifications such as MRICS, FRICS, or equivalent commercial or quantity surveying qualifications would be an advantage.

9e814e2cc64c3761.description: Eram Talent is hiring on behalf of its leading Petrochemical client for a Construction Representative to support major petrochemical projects and construction activities. The client is seeking an experienced construction professional with a strong background in petrochemical project execution, construction supervision, quality assurance, and field activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of construction activities while ensuring compliance with EHS requirements, quality standards, project specifications, schedules, and cost objectives. Key Responsibilities Ensure the construction phase meets EHS, quality, schedule, productivity, and cost objectives. Support the successful planning, execution, supervision, handover, and completion of construction activities in accordance with contracts, specifications, and standards. Coordinate with project, operations & maintenance functions to achieve project goals. Ensure construction safety plans, specifications, procedures, regulatory requirements, and permits are implemented in accordance with Sadara EHS requirements and work processes. Promote a zero-incident culture through safety campaigns, site walks, stand-downs, and related activities. Participate in constructability studies, 3D model reviews, risk reviews, internal progress meetings, root-cause investigations, schedule reviews, audits, and lessons-learned meetings. Support initiation of contractor claims and change-order requests through the Project Lead Engineer when defects, contractual inconsistencies, or scope changes are identified. Ensure implementation of quality control plans and involvement of Asset Integrity experts, where required. Monitor and control construction, including changes, additions, work acceptance, and invoice release. Review job specifications to determine suitable construction methods. Ensure red-lined technical documents are available and reflect the current as-built site condition. Participate in project closeout and provide feedback to design teams and contractors. Participate in contractor qualification and selection, construction strategy development, and handover to commissioning. Matching Construction contractor hours of working will be required, likely needing 6 days working week, overtime & potential night shift activities. Perform other job-related activities requested by the immediate supervisor or manager. Two-year associate degree in a relevant field. Minimum 7 years of experience across phases of chemical or petrochemical projects. 5 years experience of quality checks and field quality assurance activities during construction. Relevant experience in project construction within the petroleum or petrochemical industry. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and SAP.

9ed33bda2745c8a4.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Senior Ethics Specialist to join its team in Jeddah. This contract position involves contributing to the development and implementation of proactive measures to reduce ethics violations, misconduct, fraud, and corruption within the Bank Group. The role focuses on fostering an ethical environment through awareness, training, and policy support, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on prevention activities and programs to ensure compliance with the Bank Group Code of Ethics. Provide policy support for the review and development of internal procedures and manuals within the Group Integrity and Ethics Department (GIED). Integrate ethics into Bank policy documents and engage departments on lessons learned to improve integrity and ethics. Organize and oversee training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities to enhance ethical conduct and prevent staff misconduct. Develop presentations and materials for preventing staff misconduct. Contribute to the launch and implementation of the Financial and Conflict of Interests Program. Conduct staff misconduct investigations and prepare corresponding reports as assigned. Lead the identification and organization of collaborative partnerships with regional and international trainers or experts for staff training programs. Knowledge Management Contributions Support the organization and implementation of meetings, workshops, and video conferences to promote dialogue on integrity, knowledge sharing, and ethics. Provide administrative and technical support to Bank Group staff on ethics-related issues during major events. Contribute to the preparation of a periodic newsletter focused on Ethics Prevention and Outreach Products. Prepare annual integrity and ethics reports on departmental activities and assist in their publication. Contribute to special initiatives and undertake ad hoc assignments as requested. Capacity Building and Advisory Functions Organize and oversee the implementation of training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities for staff misconduct prevention. Design and develop innovative training tools and modules using data mining, media analyses, and compliance reviews. Contribute to the implementation of a Training and Awareness Plan for Bank Group staff. Advise IsDB Group Staff on the provisions of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The position requires a strong understanding of ethics management, integrity frameworks, and the ability to develop and deliver effective training and awareness programs. 9e083abb1472a59d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأركان الفاخرة للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان، وتحديداً في مدينة أبو عريش. يتضمن هذا الدور بدوام كامل مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. المرونة في التعامل مع مهام متعددة. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني الكهربائي بدوام كامل ضمن مشاريع شركة الأركان الفاخرة للمقاولات في منطقة جازان، وتحديداً في أبو عريش. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة حسب طبيعة المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

9eba41f2981177ca.description: About Endeavor Endeavor is a global network supporting entrepreneurs who are scaling exceptional businesses. Endeavor supports over 3,000 entrepreneurs across more than 50 countries, including founders of companies such as Replit, Mercado Libre, Careem, Rappi, *********, and ElevenLabs. This full-time position involves delivering high-impact programs and initiatives, alongside providing tailored support to founders within the Endeavor network. Candidates should have 0-1 years of experience. Qualifications and Requirements Completed Higher Education (Bachelor’s Degree). Experience in scale-ups, consulting (strategic or accounting), investment funds, and/or other accelerators/ecosystem institutions is preferred. Willingness to travel both locally and internationally. Required Skills and Competencies Organizational Discipline: Ability to manage multiple accounts and projects concurrently while maintaining attention to detail and commitments. CRM, Tracking Tools, and AI: Beginner to intermediate proficiency in AI for workflows. Familiarity with G-Suite, Salesforce, Notion, Claude, Asana, and ChatGPT is a strong advantage. Research and Synthesis: Capability to ask relevant questions to quickly understand company context, stage, and key challenges. Communication: Clear and warm communication skills, both written and in-person. Fluent spoken and written English is required. Passion for Entrepreneurship: Genuine belief in Endeavor's mission and the founders it supports. Reliability: Self-starter with a willingness to learn quickly. Intellectual Curiosity: Desire to understand the motivations of founders and the analytical reasoning behind the challenges they face. Adaptability: Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments with constant changes and shifting priorities. Role Development During the initial 3–6 months, the Analyst will develop a comprehensive understanding of Endeavor's mission, network, and approach to supporting founders. This period will also involve beginning to identify high-potential entrepreneurs and guiding them through the Selection process. This role requires a combination of analytical rigor, relationship-building, and strong execution skills to support entrepreneurs in building category-defining companies.

9e1815f29be98a1e.description: We are looking for qualified NDT Technicians specializing in Radiographic Testing Film Interpretation (RTFI), Penetrant Testing (PT), or Ultrasonic Testing (UT) to join our PED Division at Salama Engineering. Ability to read technical drawings, follow approved inspection procedures, and maintain accurate documentation. Strong attention to detail, quality awareness, and commitment to workplace safety.
